'''Brother Graham''' is a human quest giver located at the [[Ambershire Church]] in [[Northwind]]. Though he was a native of Northwind, his mother died when he was young and he left to Stormwind, joining the [[Church of Light]]. He later returned to Northwind on the recommendation of [[Archbishop Benedictus]] to assist [[Sister Argent]] in her educational duties.<ref name="The Grateful Dead"/>
